reasoning: Roofline marks compute bottleneck with compute SOL 60.8% vs memory SOL 30.7%; SM throughput is 60.85% of peak while DRAM/TCC utilization is 30.68%, so arithmetic pipelines are the first limiter rather than bandwidth.

root_causes.cause: No matrix-core/tensor-core path is used, so matmul runs on VALU/scalar pipelines with lower effective math throughput.

evidence.interpretation: Tensor/matrix units are completely idle during GEMM.

fixes.fix: Retune kernel to use MFMA/tensor-op compatible tiling and datatypes (prefer fp16/bf16 accumulation path that maps to matrix instructions) so Triton emits matrix-core instructions.
fixes.rationale: Activating matrix units can significantly raise compute throughput for matmul versus pure VALU execution.

root_causes.cause: Instruction mix indicates heavy non-tensor arithmetic/control overhead relative to peak math issue rate.

evidence.interpretation: Most work is on VALU with additional scalar/misc instructions, indicating high instruction overhead per tile and limiting peak FLOP utilization.

fixes.fix: Autotune for larger compute tiles and deeper pipelining (e.g., favor larger BLOCK_K/BLOCK_M/BLOCK_N and stages that reduce loop/control overhead per FLOP).
fixes.rationale: Increasing work per iteration improves arithmetic intensity and lowers instruction overhead, helping SM throughput move closer to peak.
